dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: The meeting, of course. I overslept this time...

dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: The last time, I got the commission time wrong, and I only realized it when the client came a-knocking...

dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: So this time, I did get the time right, but I overslept because I had spent the entire night before preparing my gear and supplies...

dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: I wonder if this means I'm really not suited to be an adventurer...
